page.title: Self-hosted human verification
page.description: This plugin issues and verifies its own challenges: no site key to obtain, no third-party service, and no way for an outside outage to block sign-in. Installing it is all the setup there is — every guarded action is protected by default.
page.noSecrets: The platform has no encryption key (SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY), so the plugin cannot store its signing key and stays idle. Sign-in and other actions then run unverified rather than failing.
page.keyFingerprint: Local signing key fingerprint: {fingerprint} (tells you whether the key changed; it cannot be reversed)
field.maxNumberHint: Higher is harder and slower. 100k is typically under a second on a phone; below 50k barely inconveniences a script.
field.languageHint: e.g. zh-cn, en. Empty follows the interface language.
field.singleUse: Each challenge may be used once
field.singleUseHint: When off, the same challenge can be replayed until it expires — troubleshooting only.
policy.title: Per-action policy
policy.hint: Required = every user must pass; optional = verify when a solution is provided, otherwise allow; off = no verification.
test.title: Self-test
test.hint: The plugin issues a challenge, solves it, verifies it, and confirms the same solution cannot be used twice.
test.passed: Self-test passed: issuing, solving, verifying and single-use all work
test.rejected: Self-test failed — check the server log
